Frequently Asked Questions

Do I need technical knowledge to use the Landing Builder?▼

Not at all. Just describe your business in plain language and we handle the rest.

What payment methods do you accept?▼

PayPal, SINPE Móvil (Costa Rica), and bank transfer.

Can I edit my landing page after it's generated?▼

Yes — we deliver the source code so you or your developer can make changes.

How is the website hosted?▼

We deploy it on Vercel, one of the fastest hosting platforms globally. Free for basic sites.

Do you work with businesses outside Costa Rica?▼

Yes, we work internationally. Payment in USD via PayPal.
